'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Bill Kafer LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' EMO SONG LYRICS
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
